contract.task_clause:
Two people, one of mass 100 kg and the other of mass 50 kg, stand facing each other on an ice-covered (essentially frictionless) pond. If the heavier person pushes on the lighter one with a force F, then
Option A: the force felt by the heavier person is (-1/2)F
Option B: the force felt by the person is -2F
Option C: the magnitude of the acceleration of the lighter person will be half of the magnitude of the acceleration of the heavier person
Option D: the magnitude of the acceleration of the lighter person will be twice the magnitude of the acceleration of the heavier person
